summary: The note previews the Local Business Fair, held September 21-23, 2023 in downtown, showcasing over 150 local businesses. It describes keynote speakers, networking, product launches, workshops, food, family activities, an Artisans' Corner, exclusive deals, and sustainability measures. It frames the fair as a way to support the local economy and celebrate community unity.
one_line: Preview of the September 21-23, 2023 Local Business Fair downtown, featuring 150+ local businesses, speakers, workshops, food, deals, and green initiatives.
key_facts: The Local Business Fair is scheduled for September 21st to September 23rd, 2023, in the downtown area.
Organizers confirmed over 150 local businesses will participate, from fledgling startups to established brands.
Martin Jenkins, a renowned industry leader with roots in the town, is a keynote speaker.
Jessica O'Neal, a social media figure who started her empire from a blog about the city's culture, is a keynote speaker.
The fair offers networking opportunities with potential collaborators, mentors, and investors; attendees are advised to bring business cards and an elevator pitch.
Workshops cover marketing strategies, digital transformation, financial planning, and sustainable business practices, and are open to all.
A culinary pavilion will host food stalls with local chefs and restaurateurs, from farm-to-fork eateries to fusion dishes.
Children can enjoy entrepreneur-themed games and craft workshops, and live music and performances are planned.
The Artisans' Corner is reserved for local artists, potters, jewelry makers, and crafters.
Businesses often offer exclusive deals and promotions at the fair, with prices more competitive than usual.
Sustainability measures include partnering with local green initiatives, promoting biodegradable packaging among vendors, and setting up recycling stations.
Purchases from local businesses keep money in the community, supporting the local economy.
